arabic text: HAYE ZAINAB LUT RAHI HE, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: WOE! ZAINAB IS BEING TROUBLED, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: SOOE KUFA JARAHI HE, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: SHE HEADS TOWARDS KUFA, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: MERE HASHIM KE JAWAANO, ZULM SE HUM KO BACHAYE
english translation text: OH THE YOUTH OF BANI HASHIM, PROTECT US FROM THESE ATROCITIES

arabic text: NOK E NEZA SAJ CHUKI HAI BIBIYO KI WO RIDAIN
english translation text: THE SPEARS HAVE NOW BEEN DECORATED WITH THE WOMENS’ VEILS

arabic text: HUM PE HAR SHE RORAHI HE, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: AND NOW THE WHOLE WORLD CRIES FOR US, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: HUM KO DURRON SE BACHAYE, KOI EK TO SUNLE NOHA
english translation text: PROTECT US FROM THE WHIPS, SOMEONE HEAR OUR CRIES

arabic text: DASHTE GHURBAT KAR RAHI HE AAJ HAM PER KHUD BHI GIRYA
english translation text: EVEN OURSADNESS TODAY CRIES ON US

arabic text: MERI DUNIYA LUT RAHI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: MY WORLD HAS BEEN SNATCHED AWAY FROM ME, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: JISKO MEHMIL ME SAJA KAR LAYE THE, ME HU WO ZAINAB
english translation text: AND WHO WAS BROUGHT WITH SUCH A LOFTY STATUS COVERED, THIS IS ME ZAINAB

arabic text: APNI NIGRANI ME RAKH KAR LAYE THE, MAI HU WO ZAINAB
english translation text: AND WHO WAS BROUGHT UNDER WATCHFUL EYES, THIS IS ME ZAINAB

arabic text: AAJ TANHA HOGAYI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: TODAY I HAVE BECOME LONELY, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: MERY BABA, MERE BABA, SHIMR MUJH KO HE DARATA
english translation text: OH MY FATHER MY FATHER, SHIMR SCARES ME

arabic text: SOOYE MAQTAL RO KE DETI, HE SADA MERI SAKINA
english translation text: LOOKING TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD, CRIES MY SAKINA

arabic text: KHAAK PE SO NA SAKI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: SHE IS NOT ABLE TO SLEEP O THE SCORCHING EARTH, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: BE KAJAWA UNTUN PE HE, AALE TAHA WA HUSSAINA
english translation text: ON THE BARE BACKS OF CAMELS IS THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET AND HUSSAIN

arabic text: HAATH BANDE QAID HO KER, JAA RAHE HAI WA GHAREEBA
english translation text: WITH HANDS TIED LIKE PRISONERS THEY ARE TAKEN

arabic text: AAJ ZAHRA RO RAHI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: TODAY EVEN ZAHRA CRIES, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: AALE EHMAD SEH NA PAAYENGE SITAM KI TAZIYANE
english translation text: FROM THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET WE WILL NOT RECEIVE COFFINS AMD MOURNERS

arabic text: PHOOL SE CHEHRUN PE PARHTEY SHIMR KE WO TAMACHE
english translation text: AND ON SUCH YOUTHFUL FACES, SHIMR HAS SLAPPED THEM

arabic text: BE BASI AB CHA GAYI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: HOPELESSNESS HAS NOW BEFALLEN US, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: JAISE MAQTAL AYA SHAHID, KHUD KO BIBI NE GIRAYA
english translation text: AND WHEN THEY COME BACK TO THE BATTLEFIELD SHAHID, ZAINAB THROWS HERSELF TO THE GROUND

arabic text: RO KE MOSHI BINTE ZAHRA, NAY YE MAQTAL ME PUKARA
english translation text: SHE CRIES MOSHI, THE DAUGHTER OF ZAHRA, WEEPS ON THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: DEKH ZAINAB AGAYI HAI, AY AZEEZO TUM KAHA HO
english translation text: LOOK ZAINAB HAS NOW COME, OH MY BELOVED WHERE ARE YOU
